questions.question: [NEET 2016 | Biology] WRONG statement about gene I controlling ABO blood groups:

options.B: Person has only two of three alleles
options.D: Allele i is dominant over IA and IB

questions.solution: ## Answer: **(D) Allele i is dominant over IA and IB** --- ## Step-by-Step Reasoning: ### Let me verify each statement: | Statement | Correct? | Why? | |-----------|----------|------| | (A) Gene I has 3 alleles | \u₂₇₁₃ TRUE | The alleles are: IA, IB, and i | | (B) Person has only 2 of 3 alleles | \u₂₇₁₃ TRUE | Humans are diploid; each person inherits 2 alleles only | | (C) IA and IB are codominant | \u₂₇₁₃ TRUE | IAIB genotype produces AB blood group (both expressed equally) | | (D) **i is dominant over IA and IB** | \u₂₇₁₇ **FALSE** | **i is actually RECESSIVE to both** | --- ## The Core Concept: ABO Blood Group Dominance **Correct dominance hierarchy:** - IA and IB are **codominant** to each other - Both IA and IB are **dominant** over i (recessive) **Genotype \u₂₁₉₂ Phenotype:** - IAIA or IAi \u₂₁₉₂ **A blood group** - IBIB or IBi \u₂₁₉₂ **B blood group** - IAIB \u₂₁₉₂ **AB blood group** - ii \u₂₁₉₂ **O blood group** Notice that in IAi and IBi, the recessive i allele is masked by the dominant alleles. This proves i is **recessive**, not dominant. --- ## Key Takeaway: **Remember:** The allele 'i' stands for "isoagglutinin-free" and is recessive to both IA and IB, which produce their respective antigens on red blood cells.

questions.question: Identify the correct statement I. The impulse of the heart beat originates from SAN II. Rate of the heart is determined by SAN III. Bundle of His/AV bundle is present in the interventricular septum IV. Atrio Ventricular Node (AVN) is situated in the lower left corner of the right auricle Choose the correct option
questions.solution: **Correct Answer: (C)** **Explanation:** All except III. Auto-Rhythmicity of Heart Automatic rhythmicity of the heart is the ability to contract spontaneously. Mammalian heart is myogenic. It means heart beat results from a wave of electrical potential called cardiac impulse arising from sinoatrial node SA node and spreading over cardiac chambers. SA-node lies in the wall of right atrium near opening of superior vena cava and contract about 72 times per minute. Form SA node cardiac impulse travels to atrioventricular node (lies between right atrium and ventricle) Then pass to AV bundle (also called bundle to His) and its branches reaches to the Purkinje fibres in ventricles. Bundle of His provides the only route for the transmission of wave of excitation from atria to ventricles. Purkinje fibres conducts the impulses five times more rapidly than surrounding cells. It forms a pathway for conduction of impulse that ensures that the heart muscle contracts in the most efficient manner

questions.question: The first heart sound ‘Lubb’ occurs in which phase of the cardiac cycle?
questions.solution: **Correct Answer: (C)** **Explanation:** Ventricular Systole When the contraction of the ventricles occurs immediately after atrial systole, the pressure in the ventricles rises and closes the atrioventricular valves, preventing blood from returning to the atria. Then the pressure opens the semilunar valves (three half moon shaped pockets) of aorta and pulmonary artery (the great artery) to make entry of blood into these vessels (ejection) This lead to reduced volume of blood into the ventricles (about 40 to 50 mL). The closing of atrioventricular valves during ventricular systole produces the first heart sound lub
